title: uuencoding-multi: base_subject invariant broken for stripped-to-empty input
description: parse_subject() violates its own documented invariant that base_subject is never empty. For input like 'Re: ' (prefix only, no body), strip_prefixes+trim produces empty string. The guard checks subject.is_empty() on the *original* input, not the stripped form. Returns Some(SubjectParts{base_subject:"", ...}) which silently groups all such messages under an empty HashMap key. Fix: after stripping prefixes, if stripped.is_empty() return None.
